caseName: American Gas & Electric Co. v. Securities & Exchange Commission
caseNameFull: American Gas & Electric Co. v. Securities & Exchange Commission
attorneys: Mr. Frederic L. Ballard for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy and Messrs. John F. Davis and Theodore L. Thau for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas, Mr. Justice Jackson, and Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
